name: Docstar
description: Docstar is a comprehensive document management solution designed to streamline the way businesses handle, store, and access their documents. With advanced features for document capture, indexing, and retrieval, Docstar enhances productivity and ensures secure document handling.

events.d: Find documents in a collection by plain-language query, page name, or page ID. Optionally include document titles and direct links.

events.n: When a new document is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new document is created.
Add a new page under a selected parent. Set the title, optional URL slug and content, and choose publish and editing options.
Search a collection for pages, optionally filtering by page name or page ID.
Display a page's readable text and basic metadata (title, page number, timestamp). If the page has no text, show 'This page has no content.'
Create an endpoint that retrieves a page's text and basic details.
Convert text into pending FAQ entries in a selected collection, and optionally send the generated FAQs to a webhook URL.
Approve an FAQ to publish or update it, or reject it to delete the FAQ.
View the full details and access link for a specific FAQ in a collection.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a document is updated.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a document is deleted from the account.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any document's title is changed.
Update an existing DocStar page: its title, URL slug, SEO details, feature image or editing via link.
